prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: GitHub README hero image for the original native SNES fighting game Abaqus: After Hours.
Primary request: create a beautiful, believable fictional retail cartridge for this game, as if an independent 1990s 16-bit fighting game had its own physical cartridge. One single authentic-shaped North American SNES-style gray cartridge, photographed at a restrained three-quarter angle with its front label almost facing the viewer. Complete cartridge in frame, large and centered, no box or controller.
Input images: Image 1 is the game's actual title screen; use its original slanted gold ABAQUS lettering and warm gold/charcoal visual identity as the label typography reference. Image 2 is a screenshot of the actual game; use ONLY the two original pixel-art fighters and the detailed Santiago office entrance as artwork reference. Ignore screenshot UI, health bars, pause text and browser frame. The bald blue-shirted fighter and dark-haired orange-shirted fighter should be recognizable as the two small pixel-art combatants on the printed label, not redesigned realistic people.
Label design: attractive illustrated 1990s fighting-game label in charcoal, amber and warm gold, with large slanted ABAQUS at top and smaller AFTER HOURS directly beneath, the two pixel-art fighters facing one another against the office at dusk below. Crisp balanced typography, original game artwork feeling. Exact visible label text only: "ABAQUS", "AFTER HOURS", "16-BIT". Do not add other text.
Style/medium: premium photorealistic studio product photography, fine molded gray plastic grain, side grooves and recessed label cavity, satin printed paper label, subtle natural wear, realistic cartridge thickness and connector opening.
Composition: landscape 3:2 canvas; cartridge fills around 85% width and 85% height with comfortable margins. Clean isolated cutout with genuine transparent background. Soft edge highlights and subtle contact shadow, no floor plane, no opaque rectangle or background gradient.
Constraints: no Nintendo logo, no official licensing seal, no Capcom branding, no Street Fighter characters, no watermark, no extra objects. This is fictional original game packaging. Ensure ABAQUS is spelled A B A Q U S exactly and AFTER HOURS is exact and readable at README size. Keep the printed artwork entirely inside the cartridge label.

references.role: Original title lettering and gold/charcoal visual identity
Original pixel-art combatants and office-stage artwork; UI excluded

scope: README illustration only; fictional cartridge, no native game assets or runtime changes.
